# Rally Flag

> Destiny 2 companion site: raid and dungeon guides, god rolls, builds, armor set bonuses, a Locker for your gear, and live trackers for what's active now.

Rally Flag (https://rallyflag.gg/) is a free, fan-made Destiny 2 companion site. Guides are written by players from their own clears; live pages read Bungie's public API.

- [Salvation's Edge](https://rallyflag.gg/raid-salvations-edge.html): Salvation's Edge is the final raid of the original Light and Darkness saga, and it plays like it: five long, intricate encounters that layer symbol logic…

- [Prophecy](https://rallyflag.gg/dungeon-prophecy.html): Prophecy is built around one core mechanic repeated three times: kill specific enemies while standing in light or shadow to collect Light or Dark motes…

- [Duality](https://rallyflag.gg/dungeon-duality.html): Duality takes place inside Calus's memories, and it runs on one shared idea: shoot a Bell of Conquest to flip between reality and a nightmare version of…
- [Spire of the Watcher](https://rallyflag.gg/dungeon-spire-of-the-watcher.html): Spire of the Watcher runs on a single mechanic the whole way through: kill Conduit Minotaurs for a buff called Arctrician, then use it to power nodes in…
- [Ghosts of the Deep](https://rallyflag.gg/dungeon-ghosts-of-the-deep.html): Ghosts of the Deep leans on one repeating idea: track down a Hive rune symbol, defeat a Lightbearer to claim a Vestige of Light buff, then imbue the…
- [Warlord's Ruin](https://rallyflag.gg/dungeon-warlords-ruin.html): Warlord's Ruin repeats one core idea across all three boss fights: stand near Taken totems to turn them into Stasis totems, which builds toward a damage…
- [Vesper's Host](https://rallyflag.gg/dungeon-vespers-host.html): Vesper's Host reuses the Scanner and Operator buffs from Deep Stone Crypt and adds a new one, Suppressor, layered with a nuke-carrying mechanic. If you…
- [Sundered Doctrine](https://rallyflag.gg/dungeon-sundered-doctrine.html): Sundered Doctrine takes place in Rhulk's pyramid, and it runs on symbols and light beams: using lenses to redirect Darkness beams onto the correct wall…

## Weapons, builds and armor

- [God Rolls](https://rallyflag.gg/god-rolls.html): Destiny 2 god rolls we actually run and why: the perks to chase on each weapon, how they pair, and which builds they fit best.
- [Builds](https://rallyflag.gg/builds.html): Full loadouts (exotic armor, exotic weapon, armor set, and artifact) built around a single synergy, with the perks explained.
- [Armor Set Bonuses](https://rallyflag.gg/armor-set-bonuses.html): Every Destiny 2 armor set bonus: 2-piece and 4-piece perks, weapon pairings, and drop sources, in one searchable page.
- [Seasonal Artifacts](https://rallyflag.gg/artifacts.html): Every Destiny 2 seasonal artifact and what each mod actually does, organized by tier, so you know which perks to unlock first and which to skip.
- [Weapon Lookup](https://rallyflag.gg/weapons.html): Look up any Destiny 2 weapon: every perk it can roll, its base and hidden stats, where it drops, its lore and our God Roll, plus the perks you own.

## This week in Destiny 2 (live)

- [This Week](https://rallyflag.gg/this-week.html): This week in Destiny 2: the featured raids and dungeons, Master raid surges and a countdown to the weekly reset. Sign in to see your own clears.
- [Rotation](https://rallyflag.gg/rotation.html): The full Destiny 2 Distortion rotation, hour by hour and two cycles ahead, shown in your own timezone so you can plan which destination to farm next.
- [Distortions](https://rallyflag.gg/distortions.html): Live tracker for Destiny 2's hourly Distortions: what's distorted right now, what's up next and when it shifts, in your own timezone.
- [Vendors](https://rallyflag.gg/vendors.html): Live Destiny 2 vendor inventory for Vanguard, Eververse, Ada-1 and Xûr, read from your own signed-in character so you see exactly what's for sale.
- [Tracker](https://rallyflag.gg/tracker.html): Live status board for Destiny 2's daily and rotating content: starting with today's World Lost Sectors across every planet.
- [Public Events](https://rallyflag.gg/public-events.html): How to trigger the Heroic version of every common Destiny 2 public event: the hidden step for each one, for tougher fights and noticeably better loot.
- [Redemption Codes](https://rallyflag.gg/codes.html): Every active Destiny 2 Bungie.net redemption code we know of, grouped by reward: emblems, shaders and ornaments. Tap a code to redeem it pre-filled.

## Player tools (look up any Bungie name)

- [Raid & Dungeon Report](https://rallyflag.gg/report.html): Any Destiny 2 player's raid and dungeon record: clears, fastest full clears, average times, Day One, Contest, Flawless and low-man badges, and sherpas.
- [Crucible & Trials](https://rallyflag.gg/pvp.html): Any Destiny 2 player's Crucible and Trials of Osiris stats: K/D, win rate, KDA and kills per playlist, flawless count, medals and Trials win streaks.
- [Seals & Triumphs](https://rallyflag.gg/seals.html): Every Destiny 2 seal for you or any player: progress on each title, gildings, and the triumphs each seal still needs, from Bungie's live data.
- [Puzzle Helper](https://rallyflag.gg/puzzle-helper.html): Interactive solvers for Destiny 2 raid and dungeon puzzles: Last Wish's Wish Wall codes, Vault of Glass Oracle callouts and more, free to use mid-run.
- [Locker](https://rallyflag.gg/locker.html): Your Destiny 2 gear in Rally Flag style: every weapon and armor piece across your characters and vault, with our God Roll matches and armor set progress.
- [Your Week](https://rallyflag.gg/your-week.html): Your Destiny 2 week: this week's featured raids and dungeons for each character, plus milestones, bounties, quests, season pass and seals.

## Optional

- [Distortions FAQ](https://rallyflag.gg/faq.html): How Destiny 2 Distortions work: what they are, when they rotate, what drops, and what's worth farming, answered in plain words.
- [Community tools](https://rallyflag.gg/tools.html): The outside Destiny 2 tools we use and recommend, from item managers to raid reports, and where Rally Flag has its own.
- [Privacy](https://rallyflag.gg/privacy.html): Rally Flag's privacy policy: what the site and RallyBot read from Bungie, what stays in your browser, what syncs, and what's never stored.
- [Terms](https://rallyflag.gg/terms.html): Rally Flag's terms of service for the website and RallyBot: an unofficial Destiny 2 fan project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Bungie.
